E2 綿 - 絹 guard relies on 綿 wadding sense including silk; need its displayed title and text

E5 維 - 絹 guard on fibre; need 維 card senses
E6 掛 - 絹 snare-gloss guard; need 掛 card senses to judge necessity
E7 弧 - 虹 arc guard; need 弧 title/senses
E8 蛇 - 虹 creature guard; need 蛇 card text and its exclusions
E9 攻 - 虹 せめる guard; need 攻 senses for the consistency comparison with D13-D15
